verifiedInLocalFork: Wrap one PMON into one realPROTO with backing.
An ephemeral local account signs the realPROTO EIP2612 domain/nonce; engine allowance starts at0.
One external openPacksWithPermit call consumes the actual token permit, burns exactly onePROTO and transfers one backingPMON to burnAddress.
PROTO nonce increments once and exact allowance is consumed; PMON total supply is unchanged.
Actual wrapper request and engine RequestCreated log bind the paid fee, request/original and payer.
An explicit synthetic wrapper callback mints the original to that payer.
limitations: Fresh proxies and a single-variant test catalog exist only in local fork memory. This does not activate or test the deployed proxy upgrade.
The gas price is fixed at1gwei for this fixture; its wrapper quote is not a current public price.
Fulfillment is an authenticated synthetic callback, not new mainnet oracle delivery.
First mainnet permit purchase and its genuine callback remain pending.

initialHarnessAttempt.cause: Wrapper lastRequestId was not the engine request identifier. The final test uses the actual engine RequestCreated event.
